title: Zero Hour Pungent Saudi Arabian Lamb Tagine
description: A pungent and gooey Saudi Arabian dish featuring hind shank, perfect for a lazy Sunday, this low-carb-friendly recipe is served in a ramekin.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a small bowl, mix together the shio cure, cumin, coriander, cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper.
Rub the spice mixture all over the lamb hind shank, making sure to coat it evenly.
Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Sear the lamb hind shank until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes per side.
Remove the lamb from the pot and set it aside.
Add the chopped onion to the pot and cook until it is softened and lightly browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger to the pot and cook for 1 minute.
Return the lamb to the pot and add enough water to cover the lamb.
Cover the pot and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Braise the lamb for 2 1/2 hours, or until it is tender and falling off the bone.
